Name: brynmawr's subtle emote edits
Author: brynmawr
Description:
made a couple small edits to the emotes that show up above characters' heads in cutscenes and such. figured i might as well release it to the public.

changes are as follows:
- made the highlights on the heart more pink/purple than orange/yellow
- changed the :3 smiley face to a :) one
- changed the X over the fish hook (?) to a dark red in hopes of making it more legible
- moved the eyebrows on the :\ emote down one pixel

to install, make sure you have content patcher, then unzip the folder in your mods folder. voila, edited emotes.
